import tslearn.metrics

# s1 and s2 are 1-D series ndarrays of shape (40,)
# max_length must be >= max(len(s1), len(s2))
max_length = max(len(s1), len(s2)) + 5

# Compute constrained DTW between s1 and s2
cost = tslearn.metrics.dtw_limited_warping_length(s1, s2, max_length=max_length, be="numpy")

# Compute constrained DTW between s1 and itself (should be exactly 0.0)
cost_same = tslearn.metrics.dtw_limited_warping_length(s1, s1, max_length=max_length, be="numpy")

assert cost >= 0.0, "DTW cost must be non-negative"
assert cost_same == 0.0, f"DTW cost of a series with itself should be 0.0, got {cost_same}"

print(f"__CHECK__ dtw_limited_warping_length {cost:.4f}")
